root_cause: NetworkTab copies a selected raw request URL into the replay matcher and URL-derived name; savePattern persists both unfiltered. Exact replay then requires the old credential value, and current ambiguity identity uses the raw URL.
ruling: Preserve ordinary query values and exact request identity. Mask recognized credential values at display and the actual save sink; let the person mark each unknown key as a credential before save. Across reruns, a rotated value matches the same saved recipe. Within one capture window, distinct credential values remain distinct transient identities and produce ambiguity rather than an arbitrary result.
privacy_boundary: Recognized and explicitly chosen credential URL values are replaced before network_capture persistence. Unknown keys cannot be universally classified; the UI says so and offers a per-key choice. The original capture event stays transient. Existing historical database rows need a separate hygiene assessment; no DB migration or desktop log rewrites are in this patch.
D47_overlap: D47 scratch design also owns src/lib/data-pattern/run-interactive.ts and network-tap timing/document provenance. D48 changes only saved URL matching, identity comparison, and safe no-match text in run-interactive; it does not alter listener timing, CDP transport, or capture lifecycle. Reconcile D47's eventual runner with these identity guards before integration.
